bio: Sanic is depicted as a crudely drawn Sonic with a peach-colored, wide, elliptical muzzle with a single squiggly line mouth and poorly drawn eyes with long pointy quills on his back he has a huge quill. He has skinny limbs with white circular gloves and red shoes without white stripes. He lacks Sonic's ears, conjoined eyes and tan arms.
